result.summary: Second audit, round 3. Slot a (E, core F) passes at novelty 3 / soundness 3 with no seeds struck. The PI changed the content, not just the wording: the precision-conditioning branch is gone and the slot is now placebo decomposition. The new seeds are the burst-side placebo, the double-placebo controls and the sign seed compared within timing-level deciles. All 9 seeds are below 0.7 against every head and at most 0.15 against the controls. The core is below 0.5 against every control. The P_l pair is the weakest. Seed 8 is close to seed 3 (0.659 vs 0.666), and part of seed 7's distance from head 1 comes from the equal-weight -rank(P_l) term rather than from removing anything. Neither is a trap or a reskin, so neither is struck. Slot b (N, overnight vs intraday) is unchanged, its 14 seeds are word-for-word the same, and it stays at 4 / 4 with no strikes. All four R groups get soundness 3. R1 and R4 are unchanged. R2 now targets the right head, and its variants have rho 0.66-0.87 with it, so replacement can work. R3 swaps only the screen (rho 0.57 / 0.70). However, R3 variant 2 is 0.494 against liquidity and 0.495 against the known family. If it wins, it should be treated as a suspected trap 3. Reading note: as recorded in the file header, I also read this round's r3/audit_record.json and touched r3/missions_final.yaml with a grep. Neither is on the section 5 list. No judgment depends on them.
